proposal.summary: Session tokens in RWS WorldServer 11.7.3 and earlier have low entropy and can be enumerated, allowing unauthorized access to user sessions.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review session token generation and entropy sources in WorldServer; implement cryptographically secure random session identifiers and rotate existing sessions. Perform an access review for potentially impacted accounts and notify affected users to re-authenticate.
